messages.author: Ingrid Voss
messages.text: The contamination starts with the 03-03 delivery — everything margin loaded from HLD-2026R2 is suspect. The February partitions and 03-02 ran on R1 and stand.

messages.author: Femi Oyelaran
messages.text: Close prep owns XL's night windows Wednesday and Thursday. Nobody touches those without me, whatever pricing is feeling.

messages.author: Rei Tanaka
messages.text: STD's day window Thursday is open after the replication move; that is the realistic home for a four-partition rerun at about 55 minutes each.
